other_conditions: No member of the applicant's family should be employed in the public or private sector
No member of the applicant's family should be an income tax or sales taxpayer
No member of the applicant's family should be a current or former MP/MLA or a chairman of any board, corporation, or undertaking
Age relaxation of up to 5 years is allowed for SC or BC applicants
benefits_summary: Registered candidates are eligible for all benefits provided by the Employment Department.
